environment.storage: local NVMe for every input, output and scratch file

method: STAR Suite 1.9.4 STAR-SLAM (in-aligner T>C conversion detection, external BED SNP mask and new-to-total RNA ratio estimation) was run on the public GRAND-SLAM 100K-read human fixture and its gene-level new-to-total RNA ratios were compared with the fixture's GRAND-SLAM reference values by Pearson correlation at minimum read-count thresholds.
limitations: The fixture is small; its elapsed time reflects genome loading more than conversion processing.
Parity is against the fixture's reference values, not an independent ground truth.
